description: Report where a translation key is called in this project’s source code, or list the keys nothing appears to call. Use this instead of grepping: it knows the call shapes of each supported framework, matches the spelling the runtime actually uses rather than the merged key, and refuses rather than guessing when it cannot read your code. "Not referenced" is what the scanner SAW, not a verdict — read the caveat before deleting anything. Reads only; writes nothing.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous result. Opaque — pass it back, do not parse it.

key.description: A merged key, exactly as prepare_translation_plan spells it. Omit to list unused keys.

limit.description: Maximum unused keys per page. Default 200, maximum 2000. Ignored when key is given.

name: read_key_usage
title: Find where a key is used, or which keys are unused
